notes.title: Fallen Mankind MMO is now on steam!
notes.content:
[b]Fallen Mankind MMO Steam page has been launched![/b]

Game is official now and steam page is live! this is our great start of this long journey which i will keep you guys updated the most as i can.

[b]What to expect?[/b]
Please everybody join our discord for more dev news, sometimes even many times per day.
https://discord.gg/JcuVhxnv2c there you can suggest new features and see transparent developing about the project, im not keeping anyone in dark while creating this dream project of mine!

[b]What about alpha testing?[/b]
There will be public alpha testing in future, join the discord to hear about these more.

[b]Is there something i can do?[/b]
If you would like to give hand in the project also join the discord!

[b]When i can play the game?[/b]
BETA stage and early access in scheduled in year 2025

Love you guys, and please wishlist the game!
